before.title: Implement Order Submission Flow
before.description: Develop order submission logic that forces sign-in, prevents empty cart submission, creates an order record, and displays a reference number.

after.title: Implement Order Submission Flow
after.description: Implement order placement requiring successful sign-in before placement, rejecting empty-cart submission, creating one order with the selected products and quantities, and displaying its reference on successful submission. No numeric reference format is specified.

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart

after.then: the selected available product is present in that customer's cart

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items.

before.given: A customer has items in the cart
before.then: the system creates one order containing selected items and quantities

source.quote: A successful submission creates one order containing the selected items and quantities and displays its reference.

after.given: A signed-in customer has a nonempty cart containing available selected products with positive whole-number quantities
after.when: the customer successfully submits the cart as an order
after.then: exactly one order is created containing the same selected products and quantities; the successful-submission result displays that order's reference

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in but must sign in before placing an order. Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items. Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts. Orders are submitted for staff processing; online payments and shipping integrations are outside the first release. A successful submission creates one order containing the selected items and quantities and displays its reference.
